_read_me: The one list of every analytics event Dealo sends to Mixpanel (project DealO, EU data residency).

HOW TO ADD AN EVENT: 1) add it below with a one-line meaning, its surfaces and its properties; 2) fire it in code with a literal name; 3) run .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_tracking_plan.py -q. The test fails if code fires a name that isn't listed here, if a listed event is never fired, or if a name is built dynamically.
Prefer adding a property to an existing event over a new near-duplicate event.

Shared funnel (same name on every surface): Session Started -> Product Searched / Checkout Detected -> Deal Shown -> Shop Link Opened / Voucher Site Opened -> Purchase Recorded -> Purchase Status Changed.

identity.$device_id: Anonymous id. Website: the visitor's dealo_user_id (only after consent). Extension: an id created at install. WhatsApp: wa-<scrambled phone>. Also sent as dealo_id.
identity.$user_id: A known person. Only WhatsApp has one: wa:<phone>. An event carrying both ids joins every earlier event of that device to the person.
identity.links: Website -> WhatsApp: the bot's pre-filled message carries (ref <website id>) and the bot fires Identity Linked. Every shop link carries the device id as affiliate subid, so purchases come back already attributed.

common_properties.surface: web | whatsapp | extension (server events take the surface of the link that was clicked)
common_properties.app_version: Git commit (backend, website) or version number (extension) that sent the event
common_properties.is_internal_tester: True for the team's own devices/phones — filter these out of real numbers

Session Started.description: A visit or conversation began. Website: page load. WhatsApp: first message after 30 quiet minutes.

properties.is_returning_visitor: web: this browser has been here before
properties.landing_page: web: path the visit started on
properties.referrer_domain: web: site that sent the visitor, or direct
properties.utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, ut: web: campaign tags on the landing URL
properties.ad_source_type, ad_source_id, ad_source_: whatsapp: click-to-WhatsApp ad that started the chat

Page Viewed.description: Website route shown (fires on every route change).

Product Searched.description: Someone searched for a product (text or pasted link).

properties.input_type: products | url | brand_voucher (web) or product_name | url (whatsapp)

Deal Shown.description: Dealo showed its recommended way to buy a product.

properties.has_voucher: Whether the route uses a gift voucher

Shop Link Opened.description: Someone opened a shop link through /go (fired by the backend for every surface). The affiliate link carries subid=device id, subid2=click_id, subid3=surface.

properties.click_id: Unique per click; comes back on purchases as subid2
properties.ctx: Where the link was, e.g. check_page_step, redeem_step, direct_buy_step, product_card
properties.brand: Brand matched from the shop domain
properties.is_bot: A link-preview bot, not a person — exclude from funnels

Voucher Site Opened.description: Someone opened a gift-voucher partner page (Gyftr / Maximize / BuyHatke) through /out.

Card Link Opened.description: Someone opened a credit-card application link through /out.

Identity Linked.description: Two surfaces were recognised as the same person (website visitor opened WhatsApp through the website button).

properties.from_surface: Surface whose id was joined to this person

Purchase Recorded.description: An affiliate network reported a sale from one of our shop links. Sent by scripts/sync_affiliate_purchases.py, timed at the sale date.

properties.click_id: The Shop Link Opened click, when the network returns it
properties.status: Network status when first seen, e.g. pending
properties.click_surface: Surface the click came from, when returned

Purchase Status Changed.description: A reported sale moved status (e.g. pending -> validated, rejected, paid).

Dashboard Opened.description: Website app loaded (legacy; same moment as Session Started).

Searched.description: Website search returned (legacy; see Product Searched).

Selected Product.description: Website visitor picked a product from the candidates.

Viewed Deal.description: Website results shown (legacy; see Deal Shown).

Clicked Buy Link.description: Website journey step button clicked (voucher or checkout).

Clicked Alternatives Toggle.description: Website visitor opened or closed the other routes.

Clicked Brand Voucher Link.description: Website brand directory voucher link clicked.

WhatsApp Onboarded.description: Welcome message sent to a phone not seen since the server last restarted (resets on restart; use Mixpanel's first-time filter for true new users).

WhatsApp Nudge Sent.description: Bot couldn't act on a message and nudged the user.

WhatsApp Rate Limited.description: Phone hit the hourly search limit.

WhatsApp Search.description: WhatsApp search started (legacy; see Product Searched).

WhatsApp Picker Shown.description: Bot asked the user to pick the exact product.

WhatsApp Recommendation Shown.description: Bot sent the recommended route (legacy; see Deal Shown).

WhatsApp Buy Step Shown.description: Bot sent the buy step (voucher or direct).

WhatsApp Card Offer Shown.description: Bot suggested a credit card for extra cashback.

WhatsApp Alternatives Requested.description: Bot listed other ways to buy.

WhatsApp No Alternatives.description: User asked for other routes but there were none.

WhatsApp Session Expired.description: User replied after their session expired.
